baseline.equivalence_test: baseline selection is computed from the same frozen candidate rows

core_invariants: Retrieval, Generator, evaluator, and answer path remain frozen
Selector sees only question and online Top-50 candidate fields
Silver evidence labels are read only in the post-selection diagnostic branch
Exactly five unique passage IDs are emitted in deterministic order
No GPU, model loading, retrieval, or generation call is allowed in this preflight

plugins.hypothesis: Answer Scorer ordering is the frozen baseline for the selector-only comparison
After two strong anchors are fixed, corroborative passages form a more useful evidence chain than independent diversity alone
plugins.mechanism_delta: Maximizes question-conditioned pairwise support; it does not reward uncovered terms, new fact units, or pairwise dissimilarity
failure_signatures: broad-positive total does not beat Top-k
support graph collapses to an irrelevant duplicate cluster
plugins.resource_estimate: CPU-only tokenization and pairwise set support

composition.merge_rule: Keep baseline and intervention selections separate; compare compact post-selection diagnostics
interaction_ablations: baseline versus intervention with identical frozen Top-50 and K=5

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic fixture reproduces deterministic Top-k ordering

reproducibility.dataset_identity: rag-selector-50-detail.json fixed nq_open validation[1950:2000] case study
reproducibility.environment: Python standard library only; no GPU or model loading

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Broad-positive and direct-positive passage retention on fixed 50-question Top-50, with selector-miss count and support-score distribution

limitations: Fixed 50-question silver case study is not population-level evidence
Three-model evidence labels are post-selection silver diagnostics, not gold labels
No formal selector screen or collaborator handoff is authorized by this plan
